name: Phosophurs Undetectable Pathfinder
description: Experimental Geometry Dash input recording/replay, limited physics route planning, configurable click audio, and an in-game menu.

humanised-clicks-enabled.name: Humanised mouse clicks
humanised-clicks-enabled.description: Reserved helper setting; it is not currently connected to live gameplay input.

humanised-click-strength.name: Randomisation radius (pixels)
humanised-click-strength.description: Reserved helper setting; it is not currently connected to live gameplay input.

autoplay-key.name: Toggle autoplay request
autoplay-key.description: Replays the most recently recorded input route. First play records the route; restart and press this key to replay.

menu-key.name: Open / close menu
menu-key.description: Opens the mod menu. Default: Z.

click-sounds-enabled.name: Enable click sounds everywhere
click-sounds-enabled.description: Master switch for all keyboard and mouse click sounds.

keyboard-clicks-enabled.name: Keyboard click sounds
keyboard-clicks-enabled.description: Play a keyboard-style click for keyboard inputs.

mouse-clicks-enabled.name: Mouse click sounds
mouse-clicks-enabled.description: Play a mouse-button click for mouse inputs.

waveform-variation.name: Subtle waveform variation
waveform-variation.description: Vary the waveform between clicks while keeping the overall sound consistent.
